premises.text: Many college students have limited time and ability to make food
premises.evidence_span: we'll have limited time and ability to make food

premises.text: Cooking is about type of food, amount of food, time, temperature, and manipulation
premises.evidence_span: Cooking is really about five main things. Type of food, amount of food, time, temperature, and manipulation.

premises.text: Cookie automates the cooking process using robotics and a mobile app
premises.evidence_span: Cookie delivers that same experience in making home-cooked meals with multiple trays of fresh ingredients.

premises.text: Pre-portioned meal kits can reduce food waste and encourage healthier eating habits
premises.evidence_span: By pre-portioning just the right amount of healthy fresh ingredients into meal kits and reducing the amount of work required to prepare these meals, we not only help save people time, but we also help conserve food and encourage healthier eating habits.

premises.text: Serendi Kitchen's meals compete on price with mid-tier frozen meals but use fresh ingredients
premises.evidence_span: Our meals compete on price with mid-tier frozen meals, but the difference is that our meals are made with fresh ingredients and real food.

value.text: Consumers can enjoy fresh, healthy meals conveniently and affordably
value.evidence_span: A Serenity meal is typically priced at around $4 per meal.

notes: Technical difficulties during the demo are excluded as they do not represent premises.
